caption: The drawing depicts a glass pitcher or jug rendered in shades of light green and bluish-green, giving the object a transparent, glass-like appearance. The pitcher has a wide, round base with a swirl or ribbed pattern on the lower section, a cylindrical neck with horizontal ridges, a flared spout, and a large, looping handle attached at the top and base of the neck. The main image of the pitcher is positioned within a larger rectangular frame. To the left of the pitcher, there is a smaller rectangular inset showing a side view of the handle in the same greenish tint, highlighting its curvature and thickness. Both objects are drawn in a realistic style, and the artist's name, "Francis Law Durand," appears in the lower right corner of the image. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Glass Pitcher
